script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: EQUALS

INT. GYM - DAY

Coach RYAN (40s, intense, caring) stands before his young, determined TEAM.

COACH RYAN
(Addressing team)
We are more than just a team. We are a family.

INT. GYM - LOCKER ROOM - DAY

Best friends, Riley (18, determined, emotional) and Lucas (18, introverted, tech-savvy), discuss their upcoming competition.

RILEY
(Determined)
We're going to win this, Lucas. I can feel it.

LUCAS
(Nervous)
What if we don't?

Riley reassures Lucas, and they leave the locker room.

EXT. SCHOOL - DAY

Riley's ex-girlfriend, Maya (18, confident, sarcastic), approaches him, challenging him.

MAYA
You'll never be good enough, Riley.

Riley brushes off her comments, and they part ways.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Riley and Lucas meet with their mentor, Coach Johnson (30s, wise, supportive), to discuss their strategy for the upcoming competition.

COACH JOHNSON
(Smiling)
Remember, it's not just about winning. It's about growth.

EXT. SCHOOL - DAY

During practice, Riley and Lucas have a disagreement over a training method.

RILEY
(Angrily)
Your way doesn't work, Lucas! I've been doing this longer!

LUCAS
(Hurt)
Maybe it's time you listened to someone else for a change.

They argue, and Riley storms off.

INT. LUCAS'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Lucas receives a message from Riley, apologizing for his behavior. They make amends and plan to work together again.

EXT. COMPETITION VENUE - DAY

The day of the competition arrives. Riley and Lucas face challenges from other teams, but they remain determined and supportive of each other.

INT. COMPETITION VENUE - FINALS - NIGHT

Riley and Lucas face their toughest competitors yet - Maya and her partner, Max.

MAYA
(Mocking)
Look who finally made it to the finals.

Riley and Lucas exchange a determined look and begin their routine.

EXT. COMPETITION VENUE - NIGHT

Despite initial setbacks, Riley and Lucas persevere and execute an impressive performance, winning the competition.

INT. COMPETITION VENUE - AWARDS CEREMONY - NIGHT

Riley and Lucas receive their awards, and Coach Ryan congratulates them, praising their sportsmanship and resilience.

INT. GYM - DAY

Riley and Lucas train with their team once again, having forgiven each other and worked together to overcome their differences.

COACH RYAN
(Proudly)
You've both grown so much. Keep pushing yourselves.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
